text:
Ava: quick assist request — onboarding docs sample for CF Workers fails in prod preview. root error: `ReferenceError: Buffer is not defined` during auth signing, and POST bodies sometimes show `TypeError: request body stream closed`.
Ravi: likely Node APIs leaking in. Did the build target webworker?
Ava: sample used esbuild with `--platform=browser` but not injecting shims. bundle is ESM.
Ellen: Browser platform still pulls node:crypto in some transitive deps. We solved this before with a tiny runtime adapter that maps our SDK sign/verify to `globalThis.crypto.subtle` when `globalThis.crypto` exists.
Ava: that's promising. Any minimal shim examples?
Ravi: in our cf-samples repo we use `shims/crypto-subtle.js` exporting `sign` that wraps subtle.importKey + subtle.sign and the SDK accepts an optional `cryptoProvider` in the client config.
DevBot: deploy-preview created: ava/cf-shim-fix-19 — smoke tests running. :gear:
Ellen: also swap `setImmediate` uses. Cloudflare has no setImmediate; use fallback: `const _setImmediate = globalThis.setImmediate ?? (fn => queueMicrotask(fn));`
Kai: streaming caveat: CF uses WHATWG streams (ReadableStream/TransformStream). If your SDK relies on Node stream.Transform or `stream.Readable`, you need a converter. We used `npm:readable-stream/web` or a tiny `node-stream-to-web` helper in samples.
Ava: tried `import { Buffer } from 'buffer'` but still failed because a dependency imports `node:crypto`. Could alias `node:crypto` to empty shim at bundle time?
Ravi: yes, esbuild `--inject` or bundler alias can do it. Example: `esbuild ... --inject=./shims/buffer.js --define:process.env.NODE_ENV='"production"' --platform=neutral`. For webpack/rollup use resolve.alias: { 'node:crypto': './shims/crypto-subtle.js' }
Ellen: typing gotcha: Wrangler dev server complained `Cannot use import statement outside a module` until we set `wrangler.toml` `type = "esm"` and produced an ESM build artifact. Add that to the README.
DevBot: CI run: 11/12 checks passed. streaming-smoke still failing.
Ava: streaming failure stack from preview: `TypeError: TransformStream is not a constructor` — seems preview injected a polyfill that doesn't match spec.
Kai: file an issue with preview id + stack. Also add a small failing unit test that asserts webstreams are used instead of node streams. That'll prevent regressions.
Ravi: I'm going to draft an SDK change to accept `targetRuntime: 'node' | 'webworker'` in client opts so core code can guard Node-only calls. Makes bundling decisions clear.
Ava: ok plan: Raven will open PR with shim + README changes, Kai will add failing test, Ellen will add minimal crypto adapter example to samples. Leaving the preview up until streaming test green. Thanks! :pray:
